audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[1] tells you she lands a 'third-Q AoE stun'. Broken Wings' third cast is a KNOCKBACK, not a stun — Riot's text: 'can be reactivated three times... with the third hit knocking back nearby enemies.' The only stun in her kit is Ki Burst (W).
audit.why: It changes what you hold. A knockback displaces you out of her range and can be walked back into; a stun means you are locked in place for her full combo. Telling a Gnar he is stunned by the third Q makes him give up windows he still has.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[1] rewritten to knockback-into-Ki-Burst, and dosFull[2].d now states the distinction directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both report[8].t and breakdown.late prescribe anti-heal, and report[8].t says 'his healing fights your pattern'. Riven has no heal anywhere in her kit — passive, Q, W, E and R are blade charges, a dash-combo, a stun, a shield-dash and a damage steroid.
audit.why: Buying Executioner's Calling into a champion with zero healing is a wasted 800 gold in a lane the page itself rates as a coinflip on item timings.
audit.corrected: Both strings rewritten to drop anti-heal and point the gold at armour instead. The 'his' pronoun goes with it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four level-chart rows contradict their own why text. whys[1] describes a chunky free trade but win[1] is Skill; whys[4] literally says "it's a coinflip on your Rage timer" but win[4] is Gnar; whys[5] and whys[6] both describe an even, form-dependent lane but read Riven.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Gnar, Gnar, Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Skill] and matches every why line and the 49.9% win rate.
audit.corrected: Four rows flipped as one atomic group in both layers; level 2 to 7/10, the three Skill rows to 5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects records that this matchup never names a single one of Riven's abilities, and the full-layer phases were untouched template text with no cooldowns.
audit.why: Her real names are Runic Blade, Broken Wings, Ki Burst, Valor and Blade of the Exile. Ki Burst is 11s at rank 1 falling to 7s, Valor 10s, Broken Wings 13s — those numbers are the whole tempo of the lane.
audit.corrected: All seven phases rewritten using the real names with Ki Burst's 11s stated, plus the 1100-vs-275 range gap in dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page says both champions carry displacement and that it is a race — her Broken Wings third cast knocks you back out of a Wallop, your GNAR! flings her out of a combo.
audit.why: Flagged in _missing for this pairing as knockup-enabler. Whoever lands displacement first ends the trade, which is the actual reason this lane is a coinflip rather than a kiting matchup.
audit.corrected: Carried into phases[4].why and dosFull[2].d rather than added as a new field.

notes: Two errors here are the kind that cost the player real resources: a stun that is actually a knockback, and an anti-heal purchase against a champion with no healing in her kit. The anti-heal line is duplicated in the champion-level itemisation template, so it is worth checking whether other no-heal enemies carry the same sentence. Riven's page also uses 'his'/'him' for her in tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, report[9] and report[12]; I fixed the two I was already rewriting and left the rest for a pronoun sweep rather than spending length band on them.
